newsitem.title: USA: Ohio House approves Cleveland school takeover bill.
newsitem.headline: Ohio House approves Cleveland school takeover bill.

text.p: Ohio House voted Tuesday to give Cleveland Mayor Michael White control of the city's public school system.
Representatives voted 54 to 40 to pass legislation previously approved by senators that allows White to choose a chief executive officer for the district and a majority of board members.
Ohio Gov. George Voinovich is expected to sign the measure when it reaches him.
The takeover plan was patterned after Illinois laws allowing Chicago Mayor Richard Daley to take control of that city's public school system.
Management of the Chicago schools has led to streamlined operations, balanced budgets and a five-year bond-funded capital improvement program.
